title: 遛鸟
title_en: Taking the bird for a walk

lines.text: 每天早上六点，杰克出门跑步的时候，都能碰到提着鸟笼去公园的刘爷爷。
lines.py: měi tiān zǎo shang liù diǎn, Jié kè chū mén pǎo bù de shí hou, dōu néng pèng dào tí zhe niǎo lóng qù gōng yuán de Liú yé ye.
lines.en: Every morning at six, when Jack goes out for his run, he bumps into Grandpa Liu on his way to the park with his birdcage.
